name: ${NAME}
description: P3B-H pacing spec: the Sigil Voice Engine on ${EP} (reference config: 40 ms engine blocks, ${PITCH} F0, the Low-latency preset) behind a ${BLOCK_FRAMES}-frame device block, ${CROSSFADE_MS} ms crossfade, output cushion ${OUTPUT_CUSHION}, prefill ${PREFILL_MS_JSON} ms. RUNS_JSON picks the runs (paced, the load simulators, the soak). Compare the cushion (-CompareVars OUTPUT_CUSHION=adaptive), the device block (-CompareVars BLOCK_FRAMES=480) and the SOLA search (-CompareEnv SIGIL_VC_SOLA_SEARCH_MS=2; SIGIL_VC_SOLA_SLACK=aligned) in one exe with run-perf-gate.ps1.
